notes: PRISM RIOT (PRIO) univ4_hook launch on Ethereum, pool ETH/PRIO. Token: PrismRiotToken, the platform's standard fixed-supply ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin v5), no constructor arguments, mints the whole supply once to its deployer (the launch factory), plain transfers, no owner, mint, pause, fee or upgrade path. Hook: TreasuryFeeHook, constructor (IPoolManager poolManager, address token, address factory, address owner) in that order, written $poolManager, $token, $factory, $owner; the constructor runs Hooks.validateHookPermissions, so the deployer must mine a CREATE2 address carrying exactly beforeInitialize | beforeSwap | afterSwap | beforeSwapReturnDelta | afterSwapReturnDelta (flag mask 0x20CC). getHookPermissions returns exactly those five flags; every other callback reverts HookNotImplemented and is never enabled. Fee: an immutable 0.5% (FEE_BPS = 50, a constant with no setter) of the ETH leg of every buy and sell in this pool, rounded up to the next wei, on top of the pool's 1.25% LP fee and the platform's protocol fee, which the PoolManager accounts separately. When ETH is the specified currency (exact-input buy, exact-output sell) the fee is taken in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; when ETH is unspecified (exact-output buy, exact-input sell) it is taken in afterSwap via the afterSwap return delta. It never alters sqrtPriceLimitX96 or the LP fee; quoting views are feeOnLeg, quoteBuyExactInput and quoteSellExactOutput, and a 1-wei buy cannot execute because the whole wei is fee. Settlement is always ETH, inside the paying swap: when the PoolManager holds enough ETH the hook takes it and forwards it to the bound FeeTreasury in the same transaction; otherwise (the launch pool is seeded with PRIO only, so early buys find no ETH in the manager) it mints itself an ERC-6909 ETH claim and anyone may call redeemClaims(amount) later. A treasury that rejects ETH leaves the fee in pendingEth for a permissionless flush(); no swap ever reverts because of fee delivery and the fee is never dropped. beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager as caller and only the launch factory ($factory) as initializer, exactly once, for a key whose currency0 is native ETH (address zero), currency1 is $token and hooks is this contract; it accepts any static LP fee including the listed 12500 and refuses only the dynamic-fee flag. The accepted PoolKey is recorded and swaps on any other key revert, so other pools and ordinary PRIO transfers carry no extra fee. Owner ($owner, two-step ownership without renunciation via TwoStepOwned) can only bind the FeeTreasury once with bindTreasury; nothing else is owner-settable and the fee cannot be changed or removed. Pool values are the launch policy's: pairedCurrency native ETH, fee 12500, tickSpacing 60, initialPrice 1:1 as a placeholder the deployer replaces from the policy's opening market cap. Companion contracts (FeeTreasury, StakingVault, Arena, OracleAdapter) are not manifest fields; their constructor arguments and post-launch owner settings are documented in README.md and docs/REVIEW.md. forge build and forge test (54 tests: unit, fuzz, invariant, deploy rehearsal, production PoolManager and reference routers) pass; the IMD protected floor tests were rehearsed locally against the built bytecode. No contract has been deployed yet and the prior job bbf45a6b broadcast nothing, so there is no on-chain receipt to duplicate; live addresses and receipts come from the deployer after independent review.
